rv.q: Torera offers a fascinating inside look at a sport, bullfighting, that many Americans may not know about beyond broad cultural stereotypes.
Apparently, Torera wants us to root for Elena in pursuit of her career.

Watching Torera, I found myself beaming, enchanted by a protagonist who exhibited the fierceness of my favorite childhood heroes, this time, against a cultural backdrop I recognized. It was a joyous experience.

cn.t: Critics are mixed on this bullfighting drama: some praise its fiery heroine and insider perspective on the sport, while others find the family dynamics overly complicated and the protagonist's motivations unclear.
